async function run(items, width) {
 for (let start = 0; start < items.length; start += width) {
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
  await mapLimit(items.slice(start, start + width), 2, async item => {
   for (const child of item.children) {
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
    await read(child);
   }
  });
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
  await Promise.all(items.slice(start, start + width).map(async item => {
   for (const child of item.children) {
    // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
    await read(child);
   }
  }));
 }
}
